title: Semantic & Context-Aware Planning V1 (full PR scope incl. K′/K″ remediation) — PlanningContextEnvelope advisory at async seams, deterministic EN/VI extraction + coverage, Unicode-boundary remediation, persisted coverage evidence, replan pinning
description: Full PR #154 scope (46b05bf..HEAD) per docs/plans/2026-10-26-semantic-context-planning-v1.md + K′/K″ audit remediations. Core V1: PlanningContextEnvelope — advisory provenance-bound context snapshot (volatile-stripped digest) assembled only at the two async planner seams (planExpander + runReplanPoolGeneration), persisted as evidence, never bound into effective_input_digest/plan_digest, never a gate; deterministic EN/VI extraction + coverage extension (outcome verbs, grouped quantities, relative deadlines, prohibitions); PlanCoverageReport persisted on attempt/preview evidence + read-only UI; zero new provider invocations. K′ remediation: Unicode verb-boundary dead code (đ/í-edged lexemes → vacuous coverage), grouped-marker quantity collapse, temporal-number floors both directions, VI anchor stop-set, render-bound enforcement, trailing-connective trim, prohibition-term leak, reask staleness, UI guard. K″ remediation: ASCII \b dead adjacent to non-ASCII-edged VI lexemes across DEADLINE_RE/TEMPORAL_NUM_RE ('trước 10 giờ'/'trong vòng 30 giờ' deadlines + duration masking both sides), CONSTRAINT_RE ('không quá'/'chỉ'/'ngoại trừ'/'<='/'≤' → ceilings can never invert into floors), LOCAL_SOURCE_RE ('cục bộ'/'dữ liệu'), output-language markers ('kết quả'/'đọc'), connective counter ('và'/'sau đó'); review follow-ups: không cần action-gate (relief-vs-ban), DD/MM + duration-range + ordinal masks, constraint-shaped backstop never promotes min, render ≤4096 bound; ONLY_VI_RE auxiliary skip-chain + VI function-word stop-set ('chỉ cần/muốn/được' no longer mints unsatisfiable onlyTerms), ordinal masks (thứ/tuần/quý/week/năm + dd/mm tails, per-unit digit bounds). Adversarial probes H1–H42 + SC-1..19 + PC-1..11. Deterministic authority/fail-closed semantics preserved; no auto-merge.
